summary: Today’s headlines: Donald Trump, ASEAN, SB19 & BINI

blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Donald Trump, ASEAN, SB19 & BINI
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Trump arrives in Manila for state visit, ASEAN-US Special Summit

blocks.text: US President Donald Trump arrives in Manila for a state visit and to participate in the ASEAN-US Special Summit, amid protests from groups opposing his policies, especially the war on Iran and Pax Silica.

items: Spy scandal, US midterm defeat heat up Trump’s Asia visit

blocks.text: After Manila, US President Donald Trump will head to China on Wednesday, November 18, where he will meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping, Russian President Vladimir Putin, and possibly North Korean leader Kim Jong-Un.

items: Climate advocates at COP31 urge probe into mass arrests at ASEAN protests

blocks.text: Filipino climate advocates at COP31 call for an independent probe into the arrests of hundreds of protesters during the ASEAN Summit in Manila. They emphasize the link between the fight for the planet and for human rights and democratic freedoms.

items: ASEAN leaders sign new power grid deal. What’s next for Philippines?

blocks.text: All 11 ASEAN member states sign a preliminary agreement saying they will work towards integrating the region’s electricity grids by 2045. The agreement focuses on infrastructure planning, policy development, and financing.

items: Making P-pop history: SB19, BINI nominated for 2027 Grammys

blocks.text: P-pop groups SB19 and BINI are nominees in the 69th Grammy Awards under the Best Asian Pop Music Performance category, adding to both groups’ recent series of major milestones. – Rappler.com
